This is because the world was once uploaded with unity 2019.4.40f1. Now that VRChat beta is on 2019.4.40f1, if such a version exists it will load that instead.
During the transition period to a new unity version, we are not recommending people to use unity 2019.4.40f1 just yet, because worlds uploaded with those versions will not be accessible to people who are not on the beta. However, because this world was previously uploaded with 2019.4.40f1, the only way to fix this now is for the world author to upload the latest version with 2019.4.40f1 so that it overwrites the old 2019.4.40f1 version of the world.
